properties.NAME: LARIMER
properties.CHANGE: LARIMER created by Colorado Territory from non-county area. LARIMER's western boundary (described as "the summit of the snowy range") was open to different interpretations. In 1886, the Colorado Sup. Ct. ruled the boundary ran on Continental Divide.
properties.CITATION: (Colo. Terr. Laws 1861, 1st sess., sec. 20/p. 55; "Grand County v. Larimer County," in Colo. Rpts., 9:268-281)
